annotations.title: Live GEO / AEO & Technical SEO Page Audit ($0.02)

description: Performs a comprehensive live technical + Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO) audit of any URL: measures TTFB, redirect chain, X-Robots-Tag, meta robots, canonical/hreflang, compression & security headers, title/meta/OpenGraph, H1-H3 question-heading density, structured lists/tables, empty CSR-shell detection, image alt coverage, E-E-A-T trust signals, composite geoScore (0-100), and ApexSEO Elite ICE action plan. Pair with ai_crawler_audit for site-wide robots.txt/llms.txt or geo_competitor_compare for rival benchmarking.

url.description: Public HTTPS/HTTP URL to audit live (e.g. https://example.com).

name: geo_page_audit

directives.description: Indexability directives (X-Robots-Tag, meta robots, canonical, hreflang).

fetch.description: HTTP status, TTFB timing, redirect hops, and header diagnostics.

finalUrl.description: Final resolved page URL after HTTP redirects.

geoScore.description: Composite GEO/AEO readiness score from 0 to 100.

grade.description: Letter grade tier derived from geoScore.

iceActionPlan.description: Prioritized technical SEO and GEO remediation actions.

structure.description: Heading hierarchy, structured lists/tables, alt text, and E-E-A-T signals.

subscores.description: Component category scores contributing to overall geoScore.
